name: Turbulence modeling benchmark
description: Specifies planned benchmark cases and evaluation criteria for comparing turbulence models and simulation codes.
evaluation_method: comparison of predicted flow fields and turbulence statistics to references using error norms (e.g., L2 / RMSE), integral quantities, and qualitative agreement of flow features; also computational-cost metrics
general_score_metric: error in predicted flow statistics (e.g., RMSE/L2 on velocity profiles, Reynolds stresses) and agreement of benchmark flow features
reputation: A long-standing, domain-relevant specification used in the aerospace/fluid-dynamics community for systematic comparison of turbulence models and codes.
notes: Not an ML/LLM benchmark—requires CFD codes and substantial compute; results depend strongly on numerical implementation and boundary conditions; comparisons can be sensitive to grid/resolution and solver differences.
